# [PR #3289] [Transform] Ensure import C source ends with a newline

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3289
state: open | updated: 2026-09-27T08:10:00Z
labels: 

## 正文

`T.import_source` / `T.Kernel(prelude=...)` are spliced into generated code verbatim; without a trailing newline the last line fuses with the next emitted line.

`tl.LowerOpaqueBlock` now guarantees `pragma_import_c` ends with a newline.

fixes #3020

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary

- `LowerOpaqueBlock` now appends a newline to non-empty string values for `pragma_import_c` when they do not already end with one. Empty strings and newline-terminated strings remain unchanged.
- Added CUDA-gated tests for `T.import_source` and `T.Kernel(prelude=...)`, covering inputs with and without a trailing newline. The tests check generated source and kernel output.

## Testing

- Added tests, but no test run results were provided.

## C++ style / lint notes

- The PR changes C++ but does not change rules documented in `docs/developer_guide/cpp_style.md`.
- CI runs the “C++ API Style Audit (warning only)” step. No audit results were provided.
